DESCRIPTION:
DW Mobile+ is a free app that empowers DW users to get the most out of their security systems anytime, anywhere. With simple P2P and QR code connection options, users can access their security systems with the tap of a finger, receiving event alerts in real time and accessing live and archived footage directly from their phones. Events can be instantly addressed and delegated as needed, saving customers time and money. The app comes with DWAIN chat for quick help and access to knowledgebase articles, tech support help and other tools from the DW website. With DW Mobile+, you know your system keeps working for you 24/7 worldwide.
 
APP FEATURES:
Access your video surveillance systems with a tap of a finger.
Support for unlimited registered sites.
Use a QR code scan to connect to supported recorder.
Remote setup for COVA bridge recorders with a myDW account.
Access live and archived videos for any system registered to your myDW account.
Push notifications for event alerts from the system
Embedded DWAIN help chat for quick access to knowledgebase articles and DW’s tech support.
Intuitive and easy to use.
Easily choose a site to view from a thumbnail image, grid or list view.
Instant remote camera monitoring and playback.
View 1, 4, 9 or 16 cameras at a time.
One-touch access to the site camera list.
Go from live to recorded video instantly.
Pinch-to-zoom to expand the timeline and adjust the search period.
Fingertip PTZ camera control.
Easy calendar search.
Supports audio from the camera on cameras with audio in/out.
Easily add time and weather information to the app.
Onscreen tutorials are easy to understand.
 
MODELS SUPPORTED:
COVA Bridge NVRs
VMAX IP G4 NVRs
VMAX A1 G4 DVRs
VMAX IP Plus NVRs
VMAX A1 Plus DVRs

quotes.text:
I evaluated ZoneMinder, Shinobi and Xeoma, but in the end, I went with Digital Watchdog Spectrum IPVMS[0] running in a Docker container. Since I already have a Linux server doing other stuff (running Home Assistant, web server, etc.), I wanted a VMS that would run natively under Linux. DWS is a real, commercial-quality VMS solution (it can scale to hundreds of cameras, multiple/redundant servers, have users with different roles, etc...) so it's not free; you pay a one-time license per-camera and get lifetime updates. It has excellent, high-quality (read: usable by non-techie people) apps for macOS, Windows and Linux, as well as easy-to-use mobile apps[1]. Best of all, nothing is sent to the cloud! But I (and more importantly, other family members) can just open the app on their phone/Mac and easily look at live camera views, past events where "motion" was detected, etc. It also has an extensive REST API, and is not restricted to working with just a single brand of camera like a lot of NVR solutions. (Note that DW Spectrum is marketed outside the US as Nx Witness VMS by Network Optix.[2])

[0] https://digital-watchdog.com/spectrum-landingpage/

[1] https://apps.apple.com/us/app/dw-mobile-plus/id1454719539

[2] https://www.networkoptix.com/nx-witness/
